scale_goal_run: Walk the row without stopping: one finger per key, back to the home row after every press.
scale_goal_mirror: Mirror pairs: the left and right hands repeat one movement. Keep both hands moving alike.
scale_goal_alternate: Alternate hands. While one hand types, the other is already moving — that is what makes the tempo even.
scale_goal_finger_isolation: One finger works, the rest stay on the home row. The goal is neighbours that do not lift.
scale_goal_vertical: Row changes on the same finger. Only the finger moves, never the whole hand.
scale_goal_finger_span: The index finger's full six-key span. The palm stays where it is.
scale_goal_modifiers: Shift with the opposite pinky, space with a thumb, digits and punctuation without looking down.
scale_goal_tempo: Hold the metronome's tempo. Accuracy before speed: if you stumble, slow down.
exercise_not_found_body: The catalogue has no scale with that id. Go back to the map and pick one that exists.
exercise_locked_body: It needs keys you have not unlocked yet. Keys open in order; the map shows which one opens this scale.
exercise_mode_practice_hint: Keyboard and hints on. Does not count.
exercise_mode_test_hint: No guides. Three accurate in a row master it.
exercise_layout_ok: Layout {layout}. Press any letter to check it.
exercise_layout_mismatch: Switch the layout to {layout} and try again.
exercise_layout_typed_wrong: Those are not letters of the {layout} layout, so the exercise counts them as errors. Switch your system to {layout} and keep typing.
exercise_start_hint: The timer starts on the first character.
exercise_type_to_begin: Type the first character to begin
exercise_rail_last_frozen: These values change between exercises, never during an attempt.
exercise_rail_zero_peek: No guides: the keyboard, the key highlight, the fingers and live speed are not shown. Time, errors and progress stay.
exercise_pause_no_error: No errors so far. Continue when you are ready.
exercise_pause_last_error: Last time you pressed “{got}” instead of “{expected}”. That key is pressed by the {finger}.
exercise_pause_leave_note: A left attempt is not recorded.
exercise_pause_last_error_test: Last time you pressed “{got}” instead of “{expected}”. A Test Attempt has no hints: we will review the fingers after it.
exercise_first_hands: Fingers on the home row: {row}. Thumbs on space.
exercise_first_eyes: Look at the text, not at the keyboard.
exercise_first_go: Press the lit letter. Mistakes are fine.
exercise_mechanics_note: These strings are not words: they train finger moves.
